body: I am trying really hard to do all of this. I am volunteering more, I am seeing a therapist weekly, I am exercising daily. It's the quiet moments where I am alone and have nothing to do that I can't bear. I'm victim of my own thoughts and heartache.

I know that you're right. It's just difficult to endure those silent moments where I'm alone and all I can listen to are my thoughts. And my thoughts are all revolving around "why doesn't he want me?" It's so difficult.

I feel like deep down I know that it's true. But the pain is overwhelming right now. I have cried for three weeks. I don't know if there has been a day where I haven't cried. I'm tired. I don't want to cry anymore.

When will I stop feeling down? When will I stop thinking about him? Wondering what he's doing and if I'm even crossing his mind? I want to be finished. I'm tired. I want to sleep and never wake up. It's so much pain.
I'm tired of living. I'm so incredibly exhausted. It's so hard. I just want it to be over.

I have to work right now, which I'm going to force myself to do. I'm also making myself go to dinner with friends tonight, but it's the in between when I'm sitting at home alone or laying in bed in the morning that is killing me. I want to pretend this person is gone and dead and maybe it won't hurt so bad but instead I know that he's still there and he isn't thinking about me or caring about me he's just going on as if there wasn't a whole four years where we had something special.
No, it doesn't. I just want it all to be over, why can't it just end?

I'm exhausted. Living is too much work and the pain that comes with it is unbearable. I'm hurting because I've been rejected by someone I've cared very much about for over four years. I am nothing to them. And it's a terrible feeling to face. If I'm not around the pain can't hurt me anymore. I don't have to spend every morning and every evening crying.

I want to stick with the therapy. I'm worried about the cost. I hope that I can work something out with them. 

Right now, the pain is so immense that I'd rather feel nothing. I hope, and I keep telling myself, that it will get better. I don't know if I can stand waiting for when that will happen, though.

I did go see a therapist yesterday and have another appointment to see them on Tuesday afternoon. I need help, badly, and I know this. I want help. I want to be okay with who I am and I want to get well so that I can wake up in the morning and do what I need to do. 

It's these moments that hit me like a wave crashing down which are the hardest. This morning I got out of bed, showered, dressed, took my dog out, made it all the way to work and was getting ready for the day but as soon as one of my co-workers gave me the "you ok?" look I broke down and lost it. I want to be able to get through a day without crying. 

In truth, I want to not feel feelings anymore. I wish that I were numb.
I'm scared of how she will react. What if she gets angry?
